appDescription: Runs ready-made car routines that bundle forgotten built-in features, such as car wash preparation, child lock for kids, and switching seat positions between drivers, and restores everything afterwards.

function.name: RUN_ROUTINE
function.description: Runs a ready-made car routine: prepares the car for a car wash, sets up the rear seats for a child, or moves the driver seat to a saved person's position.

profile.description: For SEAT_MEMORY only: whose saved seat position to use, for example mom or dad.

function.name: UNDO_ROUTINE
function.description: Restores the car settings that a routine changed back to how they were before.

function.name: SAVE_SEAT_PROFILE
function.description: Saves the current driver seat position under a person's name so it can be restored later.

name.description: The person's name for this seat position.
